messages:
sara: Customer reports they were charged UK VAT on invoice INV-2026-31415 despite providing a valid GB VAT ID. They say their payment card billing country was Italy and want a corrected invoice + refund for the VAT portion.

billing-bot: [automated] Invoice INV-2026-31415 issued 2026-08-12 · tax applied: 20% · tax_amount: 240.00 GBP · billing_country: IT · bill_to_country: GB · vat_id: GB999999973

meera: Quick glance — our tax decision uses bill_to.vat_id + payer.country + gateway BIN fallback. If a valid VAT ID is present we should apply reverse charge (0% on our invoice). Looks like we charged VAT because the VAT id didn't pass validation at charge time.

phil: Can you confirm whether the VAT id validated at the moment of billing or if the gateway returned an error? If validation failed we'll need the customer proof to issue the credit.

meera: digging into the invoice metadata... found why: raw_vat stored as 'GB 999 9999 73' and our validator was strict (no spaces). Normalized should be 'GB999999973'. So it failed validation and the fallback logic used payer.country (IT) which triggered a VAT charge. That's a bug in our normalizer.

sara: Customer already DM'd a PDF of their VAT certificate and says they provided the VAT ID in the billing portal. They're understandably upset. They want VAT removed from invoice and a corrected invoice for accounting.

meera: Proposed remediation steps:
1) Create a credit note for the tax portion (£240) to zero out VAT on INV-2026-31415.
2) Reissue invoice INV-2026-31415 as INV-2026-31415-RC with 0% VAT and add wording: 'Reverse charge applies — customer to account for VAT under Article 194'.
3) Update billing profile to store normalized VAT ID (GB999999973) and mark VAT validation as PASSED.
4) Patch validator to strip spaces and re-run a quick backfill for recent invoices that may have similar formatting.
ETA: 24-48h once credit approved.

phil: I'll approve the credit for up to £240 now. Meera — please create credit note (mark draft) and tag me for final approval. Also file a bug for the normalizer so we don't repeat.

billing-bot: credit note C-2026-409 created (draft) by @meera — status: awaiting approval from finance.

meera: Created draft credit note, updated billing profile to normalized VAT id, and filed internal bug TAX-3425 for the validator. After @phil approval I'll finalize credit and reissue invoice with reverse-charge note.

sara: Thanks team — I'm telling the customer we're processing a credit and will reissue within 48h. Will paste new invoice link here when available. @phil @meera please keep me posted. :thumbsup:
